title: Boyfriend
simplified_paragraphs: 一个朋友告诉我，昨天他看见我的男朋友和一个女人一起坐出租车吃饭。我说不会的，他说他昨天没有时间吃饭。下班以后，我去他的公司，看见他和一个女人一起坐出租车走了。我打电话问他在哪，他说他今天很忙，在公司工作。我不知道怎么做，你们说呢？
traditional_paragraphs: 一個朋友告訴我，昨天他看見我的男朋友和一個女人一起坐出租車吃飯。我說不會的，他說他昨天沒有時間吃飯。下班以後，我去他的公司，看見他和一個女人一起坐出租車走了。我打電話問他在哪，他說他今天很忙，在公司工作。我不知道怎麼做，你們說呢？
pinyin_paragraphs: yī gè péng you gào su wǒ， zuó tiān tā kàn jiàn wǒ de nán péng you hé yī gè nǚ rén yī qǐ zuò chū zū chē chī fàn。 wǒ shuō bù huì de， tā shuō tā zuó tiān méi yǒu shí jiān chī fàn。 xià bān yǐ hòu， wǒ qù tā de gōng sī， kàn jiàn tā hé yī gè nǚ rén yī qǐ zuò chū zū chē zǒu le。 wǒ dǎ diàn huà wèn tā zài nǎ， tā shuō tā jīn tiān hěn máng， zài gōng sī gōng zuò。 wǒ bù zhī dào zěn me zuò， nǐ men shuō ne？
english_paragraphs: A friend told me that yesterday he saw my boyfriend take a taxi with a woman to go out for a meal. I said that couldn’t be true—my boyfriend had told me he didn’t have time to eat yesterday. After work, I went to his office and saw him leave in a taxi with a woman. I called and asked where he was. He said he was very busy today and was working at the office. I don’t know what to do. What do you think?
english_full: A friend told me that yesterday he saw my boyfriend take a taxi with a woman to go out for a meal. I said that couldn’t be true—my boyfriend had told me he didn’t have time to eat yesterday. After work, I went to his office and saw him leave in a taxi with a woman. I called and asked where he was. He said he was very busy today and was working at the office. I don’t know what to do. What do you think?
